setter.evidence: No setter code in the title and no setter named, but an application existed and the rep referenced it: 'I saw in the application that you run your own company, correct?'

prospect.name: Marian G. Samson
prospect.occupation: Runs his own company — management and driving, about 70% of the day seated, out from roughly 06:30 to 18:00
prospect.family_status: Two daughters, one 12 and one almost six
prospect.training_background: Essentially untrained. Some bodyweight push-ups. Did heavy gym work last year while using anabolic steroids and stopped because it was damaging his health. Two weeks ago bought 10 kg and 16 kg kettlebells and began training himself from Trevor's videos.
prospect.medical: Diagnosed disc problem in the back — described as compression and a bent posture, diagnosed about three years ago. New back pain that started a couple of days ago, which he links to the kettlebell training he began himself: 'Maybe I do something wrong.' Right knee injured about ten years ago and never treated — unstable and subluxes: 'if I make the wrong move, it might be hopping out'. Restricted left hip — cannot cross one leg over the other. High blood pressure for a couple of years, untreated by his own account: 'I don't do nothing.' History of anabolic steroid use, stopped last year. Sleeping about six hours a night. Reports high work stress and self-diagnosed elevated cortisol. Takes magnesium and shilajit.

signals: Wants a former self back and names the number: 'where I would like to land, to have like around 90 kilos... I can remember myself when I was having 90 kilos', from 14 to 16 years ago
Lost ground across a hard season — untreated knee, diagnosed disc problem, a steroid cycle he abandoned as unhealthy, weight gain he attributes to business stress
Carries visible regret about how he looks to his children: 'I don't want to be like that daddy, typical daddy look' and 'I cannot keep, I cannot, I think I'm too fat for that'
Already started on his own two weeks ago — bought kettlebells, cut bread and sugar — so intent is live and this is a restart rather than a first attempt

goals.text: Health first — explicitly ranked above everything else: 'The focus, of course, is my health. I will put this one in the first position'
Get back to around 90 kg from 105 kg
Fix the bent posture and the compressed disc in his back
Not look like 'that daddy, typical daddy look'
Keep up with his daughters when they run around
Get proper instruction so the kettlebell work he has started is done correctly — 'maybe to get the proper lesson'
Start a new lifestyle wholesale — 'I want to just start with a new lifestyle, new mode'

pains.text: Diagnosed disc compression in the back with a bent posture, three years standing
Untreated high blood pressure for a couple of years — 'I don't do nothing'
Right knee unstable since an untreated injury ten years ago and subluxes on a wrong movement
New back pain that began a few days ago, coinciding with self-taught kettlebell training
Blocked left hip — cannot cross the leg over; attributes it to sitting and driving all day
Sedentary work — roughly 70% of a twelve-hour day seated or driving
Stress eating he recognises and cannot stop — 'one half of your body says, come, let's eat something more'
About six hours of sleep a night
Sweet foods are his stated favourite and the thing he is fighting

evidence: The transcript ends mid-sentence at 00:18:24 — 'the amount of stress that you have, and the...' / 'Very heavy.' — with no ending of any kind
The offer was never presented, no price was stated and no close was attempted in the recorded portion
The file is 16,283 bytes against 30,000-57,000 for comparable full calls in the same folder, consistent with a truncated recording rather than a short call
The rep was mid-way into a consequence frame when the recording stops, so the call plainly continued
A second Marian Samson call dated 05/27 exists in the corpus outside this batch, so the conversation may resume there — unverified from this file
outcome.next_step: Unknown — the recording ends before any next step is discussed.

notable.note: Discovery here was the most thorough in the batch and it surfaced a stack of contraindications — a diagnosed compressed disc, untreated high blood pressure of several years, a knee that subluxes, and new back pain that started days ago after he began teaching himself kettlebells from Trevor's videos. The rep asked all the right screening questions and then did nothing with the answers: he told the prospect 'It's good to start, you know... That's the first step' and moved on, and never asked whether any clinician had cleared him to train. The recording cuts off before the offer, so what was actually sold is unknown.

quality.notes: Labels invert repeatedly — the rep's line about muscles growing faster than joints can adapt is attributed to the prospect at 00:09:22, and the daughters' ages are attributed to the rep at 00:13:15. Roles read from content. Separately and more seriously, the file is truncated: it ends mid-sentence at 00:18:24 with no close, so anything after 18 minutes is missing from the corpus.
